actions.action: Calculate all six totals for stated usage
actions.mechanism: Evaluate usage against included allowances and required charges; add optional extras only when explicitly selected.
actions.implementation: Provide labeled storage, editor, guest, and export inputs. Show six itemized totals with billing periods; mark unsupported usage rather than pricing it as supported.
actions.check: Test allowance boundaries and add-on triggers against independently calculated fixtures. Verify keyboard operation and screen-reader announcements of updated totals.
actions.risk: Incorrect billing-period normalization could create misleading comparisons.

actions.action: Separate included, required, optional, and unavailable capabilities
actions.mechanism: Explicit text categories prevent blank cells or identical symbols from conflating missing capabilities with purchasable extras.
actions.implementation: Build a semantic six-plan table with capability row headers. Label each cell Included, Required extra, Optional extra, or Unavailable, with limits and charge details.
actions.check: Using a screen reader and monochrome display, ask participants to distinguish required charges from optional extras and identify unavailable capabilities.
actions.risk: Dense cells may overwhelm; use consistent, concise wording.

actions.action: Explain differences between two selected plans
actions.mechanism: A usage-specific difference summary exposes why similar base prices can produce different totals or capability coverage.
actions.implementation: Keep all six plans visible. Add a labeled two-plan selector and textual comparison of required extras, optional selections, unsupported needs, and total difference.
actions.check: Present two superficially similar plans, one requiring an add-on. Ask visitors to identify both totals, explain the difference, and classify that charge.
actions.risk: A total difference must not imply equivalent capability coverage.

actions.action: Reconcile the comparison with checkout before payment
actions.mechanism: A shared pricing calculation and explicit reconciliation prevent required charges from first appearing after purchase.
actions.implementation: Carry stated usage and selected extras into checkout. Before payment, repeat base price, each required extra and trigger, optional selections, and total; flag changes.
actions.check: Automate journeys for all six plans. Fail tests when unchanged selections produce different comparison and checkout totals or omit a required charge.
actions.risk: Price updates need explicit explanation rather than silent recalculation.
